outcome.title: Generate the versioned UX disposition contract
outcome.bounded: exactly one schema/JSON/Markdown bundle projects canonical UX sources, decisions, acceptance IDs, and historical provenance.

rollback.boundary: remove only the Story 8.1 generator, schema, results, three disposition outputs, and final record; preserve both UX sources, historical mappings, product/UI code, and the v1-v8 prefix.
